parsed.rationale: All four members are exact duplicates of the `data` method, each nested inside a per-test-class `SequentialMockSession` inner type: `iTunesArtworkServiceTests.SequentialMockSession.data` (line 88), `LastFMArtworkServiceTests.SequentialMockSession.data` (line 215), `DiscogsArtworkServiceTests.SequentialMockSession.data` (lines 321 and 367), all within `Shared/Artwork/Tests/ArtworkTests/ArtworkFetcherTests.swift` in the `Artwork` package. The duplication is structural rather than intentional: each test class has independently copy-pasted an identical `SequentialMockSession` helper. A single top-level (or file-scope) `SequentialMockSession` type in the same test file (or a shared test-support file within the `Artwork` package) would eliminate all four copies and be reused by every service test class. Note: although the file path contains `Tests/`, the `is_test` flag is `false` on all records, so the test-fixture no-action rule does not apply.
